source_text: The Ashley Montagu Resolution, adopted on August 11, 1996, by the Fourth International Symposium on Sexual Mutilations, sought an advisory opinion from the International Court of Justice declaring non-therapeutic genital cutting of children—encompassing both male circumcision and female genital mutilation (FGM)—as violations of international human rights law, emphasizing children's rights to bodily integrity and autonomy. [28]
